{{Quote|Commander, I'm picking up a lot of unusual static. Could be a signal jammer.|Eyeball, to Cody|<ref name="The Only Good Clanker" />}}
'''Eyeball''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], under the command of [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]]. At some point during the conflict, the 212th [[Battalion/Legends|Battalion]] was dispatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bogoa]], and Eyeball participated in a [[Battle of Bogoa|battle]] against [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] forces on the world. During the engagement, Eyeball detected an unusual amount of static interference on the planet and suspected that a signal [[Jammer/Legends|jammer]] could be in operation on the world, and they reported their concerns to Cody. The [[Commander/Legends|commander]] suggested that the interference could be due to the planet's [[Coral/Legends|coral]], and he advised Eyeball to remain vigilant against the threat of a Separatist ambush.<ref name="The Only Good Clanker" />
